The site received five Google reviews (4.00 average); the food poisoning 1 star was dated 08/10, named no dish and was not raised on the call.

Justyna will step down as restaurant manager and return to head chef on one month's notice, with a backup plan already in place (AM Updates 14/10).
The site's delivery rating showed low on the heat map (AM Updates 14/10).
